svg.desc: Managed drawing preview; Unity font/input not validated. Geometry and colors come from ExpressionControl.ExpressionControl.ExpressionEditorView.Build, LayoutEngine, WidgetPainter and ThemePalettes. Virtual rows are built by their production factory and laid out with LayoutEngine. SVG uses estimated text metrics and text roles from the real widget tree. Native window chrome and scrollbars are outside this preview.
